name: smw200a-configurator
description: Unofficial configurators for the Rohde & Schwarz SMW200A vector signal generator and the FSW signal and spectrum analyzer
comment: The site itself has no dependencies and no build step - open index.html (SMW200A) or fsw.html (FSW) from any static server. Playwright is only needed to run the browser suites, and the single-file builds in tools/ have no dependencies either.
